miners.name: TradeWire Social Bot Detection
miners.description: Assess whether a social media account is automated, from the account signals in the request. Send the follower and following counts, the account age, the post volume, the username and the profile state. The miner derives the signals it can (the following to follower ratio, posting cadence against account age, a username that is a word plus a long digit run, an empty profile), then returns a clear verdict (likely automated, likely human, suspicious or insufficient information) naming the decisive signal. The verdict is produced with MiniMax under a commercial plan held by the operator and grounded in the derived signals, so this miner is not keyless. Serves the SOCIAL_BOT_DETECTION intent.

miners.name: PREFLIGHT Infrastructure Signals
miners.description: Deterministic infrastructure and on-chain signals for autonomous systems, each read live at question time. TLS verification performs a real handshake with chain, hostname and validity checks; URL safety combines redirects, headers and threat feeds; DNS records come from two independent DoH resolvers; uptime and API health are probed with per-phase timings. Gas, balances, transactions, token supply and pinned-block reads come straight from public JSON-RPC on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Linea, Scroll, Gnosis, zkSync Era, Blast, Mantle, Celo, Sonic and Unichain. Prices, TVL, FX, geolocation, papers and CVEs come from named public sources, cited in each answer.
